title: crataegus monogyna var. horrida
intro: Crataegus monogyna var. horrida, commonly known as the thorny hawthorn, is a variety of the hawthorn plant, known for its unique and distinctive thorns. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing cardiovascular disease risk, lowering blood pressure, and improving lipid profiles due to its ability to reduce inflammation and improve heart health. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus monogyna var. horrida include cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and rutin, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
